en.headline: Minor flooding hits Sha Tin cycle track and Tai Po subway after high tide
en.dek: Northeast monsoon and an astronomical high tide raised water levels slightly above normal on Wednesday night, submerging a riverside path and a pedestrian subway.
body: Water levels in Hong Kong rose slightly above normal on Wednesday night as a northeast monsoon coincided with an astronomical high tide, leading to minor flooding in parts of Sha Tin and Tai Po.

In Sha Tin, river water from the Shing Mun River spilled onto a cycle track near Yuen Wo Playground, leaving the path submerged under roughly 10 centimetres of water. People were seen wading through, and one runner said it was the first time they had encountered the track flooded.

In Tai Po, a pedestrian subway held standing water and carried a warning sign advising the public not to enter because of flooding risk. A resident said they had to take a detour home. According to Observatory data, the water level at Tai Po Kau reached 3.16 metres at 10.26 pm on Wednesday.

The Hong Kong Observatory said a strong northeast monsoon had affected the Guangdong coast, with Hong Kong generally cloudy and a couple of light rain patches in the morning. It noted that water levels were slightly higher than normal overnight because of the monsoon and high tide, and expected generally sunny weather over Guangdong on Thursday and Friday as the monsoon moderates and a high-altitude anticyclone strengthens.

zh.headline: 東北季候風撞天文大潮 沙田單車徑及大埔行人隧道輕微水浸
zh.dek: 周三晚水位較正常稍高，沙田城門河旁單車徑及大埔行人隧道出現積水，有市民需涉水或繞路。
body: 受東北季候風及天文大潮影響，本港周三晚水位較正常稍高，沙田及大埔部分地方出現輕微水浸。
沙田城門河近源和遊樂場一帶單車徑被河水淹浸，水深約十多厘米，有人需涉水而行。一名跑步人士表示，是首次遇上單車徑水浸。
大埔一條行人隧道出現積水，現場有警告牌提醒市民勿進入，有人因此需繞路回家。天文台數據顯示，大埔滘周三晚上10時26分錄得水位3.16米。
天文台表示，一股達強風程度的東北季候風影響廣東沿岸，本港周三大致多雲，早上有一兩陣雨。天文台指受季候風及天文大潮影響，昨晚水位比正常稍高，並預料隨着季候風緩和及高空反氣旋增強，今明兩日廣東天色普遍晴朗。
